goal: Crowdsource verification of hardcoded AssumeUTXO snapshot hashes against history during standard IBD
Audit hardcoded snapshot commitments automatically using the UTXO sets syncing nodes already reconstruct
agreement: Concept support for crowdsourcing snapshot audits during IBD (Sjors, optout21)
Unaddressed objection: shutting down on mismatch creates an effective checkpoint if a hash is bad (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: crashing valid IBD nodes penalizes them without saving snapshot users (ajtowns)
Unanswered questions regarding performance cost and disk flush overhead during IBD (Sjors, ajtowns)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because it provides an elective audit safeguard for AssumeUTXO hashes rather than fixing an active bug
Standard IBD already fully validates history from genesis, so the direct benefit to syncing nodes is small
